XV. Nulla tā adversā fingi posse ex hac defe-
ctione eventura, quin ea cū exitio Libertatis jā
tolerarint;& nisi deficiāt, majora sint toleraturi.
XVI. Et postremō, deliberasse jam se de
defectione ac ideo audere debere : Qui enim
deliberant, desciverunt; & in ejusmodi consi-
liis periculosius est deliberare quàm audere.
DECRETUM.
Igitur ob eas rationes Lusitani desciverunt.
EVENTUS.
Arridet hactenus & respondet voto; Cætera
adhuc in incerto.
JUDICIUM.
Justissima defectionis causa est, ubi iniqua
aliorum dominatione ad extrema libertatis est
deventum ; maximè autem tempestiva defe-
ctio est ubi omnibus utrinq; expensis iniquius
tempus quidem pro ea defecturis, non autem
æquius quam præsens potest offerri.
DISQVISITIO.

page.notes: Drop cap C in "CUm" is a large woodcut initial. Several words in the original are doubtful due to scan quality, notably "Lusitani", "deliberasse" and "tempestiva"; no marks were added as they are legible enough.
